negama.cp: adj. belonging to a market-town. m. a town-council.
negama.p: [Nigama+ṇa.(naဲgama-saṃ] (ti) CL=9 Ṇegama-prā)] (1) having a place of remote area, one who lives in the remote area. (2) the seller, the trader. (3) the story /the account that happens in the remote area.
